driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car drivers (Saval et al. 2023) with low acceleration/deceleration and high time headway; no red-running rules applied.
Compliant car drivers drawn from the 'car' distribution; p=0 for all queue_space_seeking params means they behave like car_saval but are eligible for space-seeking if tuned.
Compliant motorcycle drivers (Saval et al. 2023) with low lateral gap; eligible for red-running and early-start rules.
Compliant motorcycle drivers drawn from the 'moto' distribution; eligible for space-seeking and red-running rules.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (custom1 base) drawn from 'moto_violator' distribution; jmTimegapMinor=1.0 allows them to clear the box after opposing green ends.

traci_rules.rationale: Motorcycles have a 50% probability of running the red light when at the stop line; no swarm effect (k=0).
Targets M2/early/moto (observed mean 0.1302 share): moto_saval is the main population; p=0.1302 sets ~13% early-start probability in the last 10s of red to match observations.
Structure locked for Phase 1; all p=0 because sidewalk (M10a) requires tuning later and wrong-lane/right-lane options are site-restricted.
Field observation: most motorcycles squeeze past a standing U-turner (high p=0.8); t_wait=2s is a conservative hold time.
Field observation: cars rarely squeeze past a standing U-turner (low p=0.1); t_wait=2s is a conservative hold time.
